_doc: Why/fix/before/after text for findings that are not stack rules (quota and environment findings). Keyed by finding id.

cache_miss.title: Prompt cache rebuilt (cache miss)
cache_miss.why: A large context was re-written to the cache instead of read: cache writes cost about 12x a read. Causes: gap longer than the cache TTL (long tool call, idle), or the prefix changed.
cache_miss.fix: Keep calls under the TTL (background long jobs and poll rarely, with one blocking wait), avoid editing earlier context/tool lists mid-run, and avoid model switches mid-session.
cache_miss.before: 20-minute foreground build, then the next turn re-reads the whole context uncached
cache_miss.after: run the build in the background; one blocking wait call; keep turns inside the cache TTL

oversized_results.title: Oversized tool outputs carried in context
oversized_results.why: Each large output is written to the cache once and then re-read on every later turn until compaction.
oversized_results.fix: Filter at the source: head/tail, rg -m, jq paths, --quiet/--silent flags, write logs to a file and read only the failing part.
oversized_results.before: npm test   # 60k tokens of passing output
oversized_results.after: npm test --silent 2>&1 | tail -n 40   # or write to a file and grep the failures

repeated_reads.title: Same file read repeatedly without changes
repeated_reads.why: Each re-read pays tokens again for content already in context.
repeated_reads.fix: Read once, use offset/limit for the needed region, or grep for the lines instead of re-reading the file.
repeated_reads.before: Read file (x4), no edits in between
repeated_reads.after: Read once; Grep -n for specific lines afterwards

repeated_commands.title: Same command repeated with no change in between
repeated_commands.why: The command's result could not have changed, yet it ran again (time and output tokens).
repeated_commands.fix: Capture the output once in a file and inspect that, or only rerun after an edit.
repeated_commands.before: git status; git status; git status

retry_loops.title: Failing command retried in a loop
retry_loops.why: The same command shape failed repeatedly; each retry costs a turn and its wait.
retry_loops.fix: After the first failure read the error, change something, or stop; add a retry limit and fail fast.
retry_loops.after: diagnose once (read the error, check the environment), then one corrected run

polling.title: Polling with sleep
polling.why: Each poll is a full model turn (context re-read) plus sleep overshoot; waiting is free only when blocking in one call.
polling.fix: Use blocking waits (gh run watch, wait on a PID/file, until-loop inside ONE command), or background tasks with completion notification.
polling.after: until check_done; do sleep 5; done   # one call, no model turns

model_fit.title: Top-tier model doing mechanical turns
model_fit.why: Short turns with no thinking that only run file/git/poll tools do not need the most expensive model.
model_fit.fix: Delegate bulk mechanical work to a cheaper-model subagent or a script; keep the top model for planning and hard debugging.
model_fit.before: top-tier model: ls, cat, git status, sleep x 100 turns
model_fit.after: one script (or low-tier subagent) does the batch; top-tier reads the summary

batchable_turns.title: Independent read-only calls made one per turn
batchable_turns.why: N sequential single-call turns pay N times for context re-read and latency.
batchable_turns.fix: Issue independent reads/greps in ONE message (parallel tool calls) or one shell script.
batchable_turns.before: Read a; Read b; Read c; Grep d (4 turns)

templated_loops.title: Same command shape run in many separate turns
templated_loops.why: A loop was executed by the model, one turn per iteration.
templated_loops.fix: Write the loop in code (for-loop or small script) and run it once.
templated_loops.after: for i in $(seq 20); do curl item$i; done > out.txt

subagent_fan_out.title: Many small subagents
subagent_fan_out.why: Each subagent starts with a cold cache and re-reads its prompt/tool prefix; tiny tasks do not repay that.
subagent_fan_out.fix: Spawn subagents only for large, independent work; do small tasks inline or batch several into one agent.

compaction.title: Context compactions
compaction.why: Each compaction summarises a huge context and then rebuilds the cache.
compaction.fix: Run /clear between unrelated tasks (or start a fresh session with a short handoff note), and keep big outputs out of the context; subagents help for parallel or noisy work but cost extra tokens.
compaction.after: one task per session, /clear in between
compaction.source: Claude Code docs, Best practices (/clear between unrelated tasks; subagents to protect the context window is listed as outdated): https://code.claude.com/docs/en/best-practices

api_wait.title: Waiting on the API (stalls, retries, overload)
api_wait.why: Requests took far longer than their output size explains: retries, 429/529 backoff, overload or a stalled stream. This is upstream waiting, not local compute.
api_wait.fix: Lower concurrency (fewer parallel agents), avoid peak hours for unattended runs, keep prompts smaller, and check the API error signals before blaming the machine.
api_wait.after: 2-3 agents, staggered; retry budget in the orchestrator

idle_gap.title: Unexplained idle gaps in autonomous run
idle_gap.why: Time with no inference, tool or human prompt: machine suspended, permission prompt left unanswered, hook, rate-limit backoff or a crashed process.
idle_gap.fix: Check for approval prompts (allow rules or an auto mode), rate limits, and keep the host awake during unattended runs.
idle_gap.before: run stalls silently on a prompt
idle_gap.after: pre-approved commands; watch hook alerts on idle gaps

env_disk_full.title: Disk full during run
env_disk_full.fix: Prune caches, remove duplicate node_modules/worktrees, move caches to bigger disk.
env_disk_full.after: docker system prune / delete stale .next and worktrees before heavy runs

env_oom.title: Out of memory kills
env_oom.why: Processes killed (exit 137 / heap exhaustion) are re-run, wasting the whole attempt.
env_oom.fix: Cap parallelism and heap, never overlap heavy jobs, add swap.
env_oom.after: serialised builds with explicit memory caps

env_generic.title: Environment errors
env_generic.why: Errors parsed from tool output (inferred, no telemetry).
